# Copilot Instructions — nh-reader

This is a Tauri v2 desktop/Android client for nhentai.net (Rust + SvelteKit/Svelte 5). Follow
project conventions in `AGENTS.md` and `.agents/rules/`. Enforce zero warnings on both Rust and
the frontend. Keep all network access in the Rust backend and treat remote metadata as untrusted
input.

Project invariants (MIT, SemVer, community-health files, 18+ content notice) apply.
